title: Update PKC Urban Capital brand palette to new background, gold accent, and text colors

requirements.text: Update the global theme color tokens to match the provided brand palette: Primary Background #0B1C2D, Gold Accent #C6A75E, Heading Text #F5F5F5, Sub Text #B8C0CC.

quotes:
🎨 Primary Background:

#0B1C2D

🎨 Gold Accent:

#C6A75E

🎨 Heading Text:

#F5F5F5

🎨 Sub Text:

#B8C0CC

acceptanceCriteria: In the dark theme, primary background renders as #0B1C2D across the site (no remaining #0f172a/#0a0f1a hardcoded backgrounds).
Primary/accent UI elements (buttons, highlights, icons using theme tokens like primary/accent/ring) render as gold #C6A75E (or an OKLCH equivalent that visually matches #C6A75E).
Heading text renders as #F5F5F5 (or a visually matching token equivalent), and secondary/subtext renders as #B8C0CC (or a visually matching token equivalent).
Theme tokens remain compatible with the existing Tailwind + CSS variable setup (e.g., oklch(var(--...)) usage continues to work).

requirements.text: Replace section- and component-level hardcoded hex colors with theme tokens (or the new palette values) so that the new brand palette is applied consistently across the entire UI.

quotes:
🎨 Primary Background:

#0B1C2D

🎨 Gold Accent:

#C6A75E

🎨 Heading Text:

#F5F5F5

🎨 Sub Text:

acceptanceCriteria: No core layout/section components use the old hardcoded background colors (e.g., #0f172a, #0a0f1a) for page/section backgrounds; they use theme tokens or the new #0B1C2D palette.
Header background and transparency styling uses the new primary background color (including any /95, /80 variants).
Hero section base background and gradient overlay are updated to the new primary background color and remain visually legible with the texture overlay.
Floating WhatsApp button focus ring offset color matches the updated primary background (replacing any old background hex usage).

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them as-is).

Do not modify immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not change site content/copy beyond what is required to apply the new palette.
Do not add new sections or features beyond the palette update.
No backend changes are required for this request.
